definitions.explanation: The desire and ability of consumers to buy goods or services. Used especially in economic contexts.

notes:
{需要|じゅよう} is primarily used in economic and business contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {需要|じゅよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧/⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (there is high demand)
- {需要|じゅよう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}える→増える：01183_fueru⟧/⟦{減|へ}る→減る：01985_heru⟧ (demand increases/decreases)
- {需要|じゅよう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{応|おう}じる→応じる：02018_oujiru⟧ (to meet demand)
- {需要|じゅよう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧ (supply and demand)

COMPOUNDS:
- {需要|じゅよう}⟦{予測|よそく}→予測：03665_yosoku⟧ (demand forecast)
- {需要|じゅよう}⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧ (demand expansion)
- ⟦{内需|ないじゅ}→内需：15797_naiju⟧ (domestic demand)
- ⟦{外需|がいじゅ}→外需：12644_gaiju⟧ (foreign demand)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{供給|きょうきゅう}→供給：02599_kyoukyuu⟧ (supply)
